headline: Google puts ranking updates, feedback and AI citations in one place
dek: Google opened a Search ranking hub on Search Central on November 24. It collects ranking principles, a page for advance notice of updates and a feedback form where site owners can report problems tied to a specific update. Google also added explainers on how AI features in Search use content for training versus grounding and how they attribute sources.
why: The feedback form is meant to help engineers spot systemic problems, and Google says it does not work as an appeal for a single site. The AI attribution explainers are the closest thing yet to Google's own account of how citations in AI answers get picked.
doThis: Bookmark the stay informed page and read the AI attribution explainer before your next client conversation about AI Overviews, so you can quote Google directly.
